privacy.title: Privacy Policy

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.p1: To provide the service, we collect the following information:

li1.text: Nick, age, email address or phone number.

li2.text: Photos, bio, height, weight and role preferences.

li3.text: Your precise geolocation while the app is in use and you have visibility enabled.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
section2.li1: Show you on the map to other nearby users.
section2.li2: Allow other users to see your profile and communicate with you.
section2.li3: Manage your Premium subscription and process payments.
section2.li4: Improve and protect the security of the application.

section3.title: 3. Information Sharing
section3.p1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Your profile information and location are visible to other application users according to your visibility settings.

section4.title: 4. Your Rights
section4.p1: You can access, correct or delete your data at any time from your profile settings. If you delete your account, your personal data will be immediately erased from our active servers.

section5.title: 5. Security
section5.p1: We implement security measures to protect your data, including encryption and firewalls on our Firebase (Google Cloud) infrastructure.

section6.title: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
section6.p1: We use local storage on your device to keep you logged in and remember your display preferences.

privacy.footer: © 2026 Blow Nights App. Your privacy is our priority.

rules.title: Community Rules
rules.subtitle: Blow Nights is a safe and real space. To keep it that way, we all follow these fundamental principles.

rule1.title: Total Respect
rule1.desc: Zero tolerance for hate, harassment or discrimination. We treat others how we want to be treated. Manners are the foundation of any connection.

rule2.title: Authenticity
rule2.desc: No landscape photos, celebrities or fake profiles. We want to see you. Honesty in your profile is what builds real trust.

rule3.title: Privacy
rule3.desc: Respect the private album of others. Consent is sacred. What happens in chats stays in chats. We take care of your data.

rule4.title: Security
rule4.desc: Only for those 18 and older. If you see something suspicious, report it immediately. Our team manually reviews every report in less than 24h.

rules.report_desc: Use the report button on any user's profile. Block instantly if you feel uncomfortable. Your well-being is our number one priority.

terms.title: Terms of Service

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.p1: By accessing or using Blow Nights, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use the application.

section2.title: 2. Age Requirements
section2.p1: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use Blow Nights. The use of the application by minors is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account deletion.

section3.title: 3. User Conduct
section3.p1: You commit to using the application respectfully. It is prohibited to:
section3.li1: Harass, intimidate or defame other users.
section3.li2: Post illegal, obscene, pornographic (without consent) or hateful content.
section3.li4: Use the application for unauthorized commercial purposes or spam.

section4.title: 4. Geolocation and Privacy
section4.p1: Blow Nights is a location-based app. By turning on your visibility, you share your approximate location with other users. You understand and accept that this is the core functionality of the app.

section5.title: 5. Premium Subscriptions
section5.p1: Premium subscriptions grant access to additional features. Payments are processed through third-party providers (Stripe). Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before the end of the current period.

section6.title: 6. Account Termination
section6.p1: We reserve the right to suspend or delete any account that violates these terms or for any other reason we deem necessary to maintain community safety.

terms.footer: © 2026 Blow Nights App. All rights reserved.
